List all datasets with row counts and last_changed timestamp.

Open in SQUADS_ENV=development (auth middleware passes GET /datasets* through).
Requires X-API-Key in production.

Read rows from dataset *name* with limit/offset pagination.

NOTE: Minimal read path for local tooling and smoke tests.
The A7 federation layer (squads-api#89 follow-up PR) supersedes this
for cross-dataset analytics and semantic queries.

Returns [] if the dataset does not exist (non-error, idempotent).

schema.title: Response Get Rows Datasets  Name  Rows Get

post.description:
Upsert a batch of rows into dataset *name*.

- New key → inserted + snapshot recorded
- Existing key with changed content → updated + snapshot recorded
- Existing key with same content → unchanged (last_seen touched only)

Batch limit: 5 000 rows per request (HTTP 413 if exceeded).
Dataset name must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,62}$.

get.description: Per-domain summary cards for the cockpit home grid (over the semantic layer).

post.description:
Run an ad-hoc Cube-shaped query against a declared cube. Requires viewer role.

Routes by the cube's `storage` hint:
  "postgres"   → asyncpg pool (existing path)
  "warehouse"  → DuckDB warehouse file (ds_* tables)
  "federated"  → DuckDB + postgres_scanner ATTACH

schema.title: Response Query Domain Route Domains Query Post
